entities.summary: Zimbabwe is a sovereign nation in East Africa, Africa. Its capital is Harare. Official languages include English, Shona, Ndebele. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic (de facto dominant-party). Population: approximately 16.7 million. Area: 390,757 km². Comprehensive index for Zimbabwe covering Great Zimbabwe, Mutapa Empire, Rozvi Confederacy, BSAC/Cecil Rhodes, Southern Rhodesia, UDI 1965, Bush War/liberation struggle, Mugabe era, hyperinflation, and Mnangagwa.
